item.billys-mods.viltrumite_genome.descr: Grants Viltrumite strength and durability, plus self-propelled flight while carried.
item.billys-mods.viltrumite_genome.fligh: G toggles flight. Hold Control to boost at your selected level. [ lowers and ] raises the boost level (1–4); these only change boosted speed. Forward and backward follow your look angle; jump and sneak add vertical thrust.
